resources.string: Research shapes only — not serum testosterone predictions. Endogenous testosterone and hormonal feedback are unknown. Do not use these curves to change doses.
Only actual saved administrations with a frozen, explicit product and a known mass are included. No planned or missed doses are invented.
Recording supported; reliable concentration estimation is not supported for this formulation.
No qualified actual doses for this product. Select the formulation when recording future doses; the current selection does not rewrite older records.
Parameter sensitivity scenarios (A / B / C), not confidence limits. None is a validated personal curve.
Each scenario peaks at 1 within this window. Values cannot be compared across windows or formulations. No absolute concentration, baseline, or clinical accuracy is implied.

Official labels constrain parts of these curves, not a complete individual profile. Absorption rates and component weights remain assumptions. Full parameters, failed fits and study limitations are recorded in the source repository. No independent clinical validation.

Choose the exact product and administration route. Dose must be the recorded compound mass, not testosterone-equivalent mass. This choice applies to new records only; old unknown formulations stay unknown.
